title: Nobiletin Alleviates Npy1r-Mediated Insulin Secretion Deficiency of Islet beta-Cells via the Clock-Modulatory Signaling.
authors: Xiang, Qianru; Chen, Xiao; Tang, Enhui; Chen, Zhi; Xia, Zijun; Liao, Wenzhen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Nobiletin通过Clock信号调控Npy1r介导的胰岛β细胞胰岛素分泌，分子对接仅涉及小分子-受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Current research indicates that insulin secretion deficiency in beta-cells contributes to Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), which is associated with neuropeptide Y(1) receptor (Npy1r) overexpression from neuropeptide Y (NPY) system dysregulation. To date, limited literature has explored nobiletin (NOB) as a circadian modulator for restoring beta-cell function through Npy1r regulation. This study investigates NOB's stimulatory effects on insulin secretion via Npy1r and clock-modulatory signaling to elucidate its underlying mechanism. The findings demonstrated that NOB ameliorated hyperglycemia and promoted insulin secretion in two distinct mouse models: T2DM induced by a high-fat diet with low-dose streptozotocin, and acute hyperglycemia triggered by NPY. Moreover, NOB reduced NPY family peptides in the serum and suppressed Npy1r overexpression in beta-cells. Comprehensive investigations revealed that NOB mitigated Npy1r-mediated beta-cell dysfunction through activating clock-modulatory signaling, evidenced by restored Bmal1::Luc bioluminescence rhythmicity in mouse insulinoma6 (MIN6) cells. Molecular docking confirmed a direct NOB-Npy1r interaction, while mechanistic analyses demonstrated modulation of the retinoic acid-related orphan receptors (RORs)/Bmal1-Yes-associated protein (Yap) pathway via Yap suppression and Bmal1 activation, based on the interventions with palmitic acid, BMS 193885 (Npy1r antagonist), and NPY. Therefore, this study provides evidence that NOB can protect beta-cells from insulin secretion dysfunction by downregulating Npy1r expression and activating the RORs/Bmal1-Yap pathway.
abstract_zh: 现有研究表明，β细胞胰岛素分泌不足导致2型糖尿病（T2DM），这与神经肽Y（NPY）系统失调引起的神经肽Y(1)受体（Npy1r）过表达相关。迄今为止，关于川陈皮素（NOB）作为昼夜节律调节剂通过Npy1r调控恢复β细胞功能的文献有限。本研究探讨NOB通过Npy1r和时钟调节信号对胰岛素分泌的刺激作用，以阐明其潜在机制。研究结果表明，NOB在两种不同的小鼠模型中改善了高血糖并促进了胰岛素分泌：高脂饮食联合低剂量链脲佐菌素诱导的T2DM，以及NPY引发的急性高血糖。此外，NOB降低了血清中NPY家族肽水平，并抑制了β细胞中Npy1r的过表达。综合研究显示，NOB通过激活时钟调节信号减轻了Npy1r介导的β细胞功能障碍，这通过小鼠胰岛素瘤6（MIN6）细胞中恢复的Bmal1::Luc生物发光节律性得到证实。分子对接确认了NOB与Npy1r的直接相互作用，而机制分析基于棕榈酸、BMS 193885（Npy1r拮抗剂）和NPY的干预，证明了通过Yap抑制和Bmal1激活对维甲酸相关孤儿受体（RORs）/Bmal1-Yes相关蛋白（Yap）通路的调节。因此，本研究提供了证据表明NOB可通过下调Npy1r表达并激活RORs/Bmal1-Yap通路，保护β细胞免受胰岛素分泌功能障碍的影响。
